title: Design: Remove as default Bill To confirmation shows its question and buttons
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer P with no work orders, assets or contacts, saved as customer Q's Bill Invoices To, so one customer is the other's saved payer.
  • Start on the Delete Customer window for customer P (Edit Customer, Delete, Delete).
  • Open the attached picture bt-p6-06-after-remove-as-default-bill-to.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A window titled "Remove as default Bill To" opens on top.
  • It reads "Remove [customer P's name] as the default Bill To for 1 customer? Open work orders keep their Bill To."
  • It has a "Remove" and a "Cancel" button.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12314 (Story 12, Deleting a customer that pays for others)

  • S12-R4: “"Remove As Default Bill To" asks to confirm, in a window titled "Remove as default Bill To" with "Remove" and "Cancel".”
